name: Portugal
summary: Since 2001 (Law 30/2000) acquiring or possessing drugs for own use is an administrative offence handled by dissuasion commissions. A 2023 reform added synthetic drugs and amounts over 10 days if for own use.
callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan law, but personal use is not a crime. INEM (112) is a health service and staff are bound by medical confidentiality. Failing to help is a crime (CP art. 200).
drugChecking: Available: Kosmicare runs a free, anonymous drug-checking service in Lisbon and at festivals.

lsd.note: Own-use possession (up to a 10-day supply) goes to a Dissuasion Commission (CDT): warning, fine or treatment referral. Supply is a crime.

mushrooms.note: Psilocybin is controlled; possession for own use goes to a Dissuasion Commission (administrative). Selling or growing to supply is a crime.

dmt.note: DMT is Table II-A: possession for own use goes to a Dissuasion Commission. Ayahuasca isn't named, but its DMT is; harmine is on the NPS list.

mescaline.note: Mescaline is Table II-A: possession for own use is an administrative matter (Dissuasion Commission). The cacti are not named in the tables.

dox.note: DOB, DOM and related amphetamines are Table II-A: possession for own use goes to a Dissuasion Commission; supply is a crime.

nbomes.note: NBOMes are controlled (UN Schedule I; 25C-NBOMe also on the 2013 NPS list): possession for own use goes to a Dissuasion Commission.

2c-x.note: 2C-B is controlled and other 2C-x (e.g. 2C-P) are on the NPS list; since 2023 own-use possession of both goes to a Dissuasion Commission.

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T-2 and 2C-T-7 are Table II-A; 2C-T-4 is on the NPS list. Possession for own use goes to a Dissuasion Commission (administrative).

5-meo-xxt.note: Several 5-MeO tryptamines are on the 2013 NPS list; since 2023 own-use NPS possession goes to a Dissuasion Commission. 5-MeO-DMT/MiPT listing unconfirmed.

cannabis.note: Up to a 10-day supply (≈25 g herb, 5 g hash): Dissuasion Commission, administrative. Growing is still a crime. Medical cannabis legal since 2018.

ketamine.note: On the NPS list since 2013 (and a prescription anaesthetic): sale is banned; own-use possession falls under the 2023 decriminalisation rules.

mxe.note: On the 2013 NPS list and UN Schedule II since 2016: possession for own use goes to a Dissuasion Commission (administrative).

dxm.note: Not a controlled drug; could not confirm whether DXM cough medicines need a prescription in Portugal.

nitrous.note: On the NPS list since 2022: production, sale and possession outside authorised industrial/medical uses are banned; sanctions are administrative.

amphetamines.note: Amphetamine and methamphetamine are Table II-B: own-use possession goes to a Dissuasion Commission. Methylphenidate is prescribed for ADHD.

mdma.note: Table II-A: possession for own use (up to a 10-day supply) goes to a Dissuasion Commission; above that a court decides. Supply is a crime.

cocaine.note: Table I-B: possession for own use (up to a 10-day supply) goes to a Dissuasion Commission; above that a court decides. Supply is a crime.

caffeine.note: Not a controlled substance; sold freely.

alcohol.note: Legal for adults; selling or serving alcohol to under-18s is prohibited.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is Table II-A: own-use possession goes to a Dissuasion Commission. GBL/1,4-BD status not confirmed. Sodium oxybate is prescription-only.

opioids.note: Heroin: own-use possession (up to a 10-day supply) goes to a Dissuasion Commission. Prescription opioids are medical-only.

benzodiazepines.note: Prescription-only (Table IV); non-prescribed possession for own use is handled by a Dissuasion Commission like other drugs.

maois.note: Harmine is on the 2013 NPS list (sale banned; own-use possession administrative); ayahuasca is unclear due to DMT. MAOI antidepressants: prescription.
